changes.title: Taut chain smooth
items: Pulling a creature's chain from the treetops now brings you down to the ground in one smooth glide, with no drop at the end; let go at any height and you rise again

changes.title: Sleep eyelids
items: Going to sleep at the bed now closes her eyes: the screen darkens from the edges as you hold, and opens again if you let go early
Waking up in the morning, her eyes open the same way

changes.title: New treehouse layout
items: The treehouse's stations have new places: the basin, telescope, broom rack, hydraulic lift and workbench among them

changes.title: Makeup one colour
items: Makeup at the basin is now one colour for your lips and eyes together: pick a colour to put it on, pick the same colour again to take it off
Blush is gone; if you were wearing it, it comes off

changes.title: Mesh batch b
items: The cats are redrawn as low-poly models on skeletons: sand cat, lynx, cheetah, lion, tiger, black jaguar and snow leopard, each with its own baby, young, adult and legend, at the sizes they were
The sand cat, lynx, cheetah and snow leopard bound at speed; the lion, tiger and jaguar trot; all of them curl up nose to tail to sleep
Their legends wear plate armour cut with glowing runes: the lion's mane is flame, the snow leopard carries its tail over its back, the cheetah trails streamers

changes.title: Mesh batch a
items: The wolf, arctic fox, fennec, raccoon, red panda, otter and meerkat are now drawn as low-poly models, like home's creatures: they plant their feet, trot or bound, and their legends wear armour with glowing runes
